name: Hau plum
summary: Hau plum, ripe and dark red with a white bloom. You pick it at Na Ka from March to May.
origin: Na Ka. Dan Viet, 25 May 2026, and Moc Chau 247 for the festival dates 23–24 May 2026. Vietnam Tourism’s eco-travel note and summer note name Na Ka and Mu Nau.
howToEat: Eat it fresh off the valley trees during the harvest. A cooking method was not printed. Check on arrival.
Dried plum is a different bite. The next ripe week moves. Check on arrival.
where: Na Ka plum valley, phường Thảo Nguyên. Vietnam Tourism also names Mu Nau. The 10th harvest festival was 23–24 May 2026.
seoTitle: Hau plum in Moc Chau — man hau
seoDescription: Hau plum, ripe and dark red with a white bloom. You pick it at Na Ka from March to May.
texture: Dan Viet says the fruit on the hills was ripe, dark red, and covered with a white bloom.
